description_en: Queries the device statistics of Speech Broadcast licenses
description_zh: 调用该接口查询千里传音License设备统计
name: GetSpeechLicenseDeviceStatistics

parameters.description_en:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is displayed, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no **Overview** page or ID value is displayed, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).
